live_claims.text: Rex converts explicit Runge-Kutta and stochastic Runge-Kutta schemes into algebraically reversible exponential solvers for diffusion ODEs and SDEs (Section 3).
The ODE Rex construction inherits arbitrary order of convergence and a non-zero linear stability region from the base McCallum-Foster method (Theorem A.1).
Rex achieves near-machine-precision reconstruction under exact inversion in image-generation inversion experiments (Figure 7).
Rex improves or remains competitive on unconditional generation, text-conditioned generation, and image editing benchmarks versus prior reversible solvers (Figures 7-9).
Rex enables accurate likelihood-based Boltzmann sampling on tri-alanine with flow models (Table 1).
Rex converts explicit Runge-Kutta and stochastic Runge-Kutta schemes into algebraically reversible exponential solvers for diffusion ODEs and SDEs using Lawson methods (Section 3).
The ODE Rex construction inherits arbitrary convergence order and supports reversible adaptive step-size solvers (Section 3.3).
Rex is shown to recover reversible versions of diffusion-model solvers including DDIM, DPM-Solver, and SEEDS-1 (Section 3.3).

Empirically, Rex achieves near-machine-precision reconstruction under exact inversion while remaining competitive on unconditional generation, text-conditioned generation, and image editing (Section 4).
Rex enables accurate likelihood-based Boltzmann sampling on tri-alanine (Appendix G.5).
